articles.headline: Pochettino will now face a different pressure as USMNT boss
articles.description: Now that he has four years to plan for another World Cup, the demands on Mauricio Pochettino will be entirely different than what he has encountered so far.

articles.headline: World Cup referee Anthony Taylor lands new role in Turkey
articles.description: English World Cup referee Anthony Taylor has taken up a post as director of elite refereeing with the Turkish Football Federation.

articles.headline: Arsène Wenger: Gianni Infantino's FIFA World Cup sell-off U-turn 'absolutely necessary'
articles.description: FIFA's chief of global football development Arsene Wenger has said Gianni Infantino's decision to withdraw from a plan to sell stakes in a World Cup company to private investors was "absolutely necessary and beyond question."
